scripts.build: AGENT_VERSION=$(c=${GIT_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)}; echo ${c} | cut -c1-7) bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --env 'AGENT_VERSION*' --outfile=dist/cloudable-agent-linux-x64
scripts.build:arm64: AGENT_VERSION=$(c=${GIT_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)}; echo ${c} | cut -c1-7) bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --env 'AGENT_VERSION*' --outfile=dist/cloudable-agent-linux-arm64
